title: Canonical: jmap-mail-server Inner-state nested HashMap restructure (eliminates per-read account_id .to_owned)
description:
## Canonical-first per workspace AGENTS.md

This is the canonical extension-server template. The Inner-state restructure lands HERE FIRST, then propagates to the 7 sibling extension-server crates in subsequent child beads of bd:JMAP-grs0 (.2-.8). Each sibling bead blocks on this one.

## Sites

mail-server/src/memory/mod.rs lines 109-167. Six known `.to_owned()` sites at lines 131, 138, 149, 151, 160, 207 per bd:JMAP-x2gd.84.

## Fix shape (option (a) per epic body)

Replace:

```rust
struct Inner {
    objects: HashMap<(&'static str, String), HashMap<Id, Value>>,
    states: HashMap<(&'static str, String), u64>,
    change_log: HashMap<(&'static str, String), Vec<ChangeEntry>>,
}

fn objects_ref(&self, type_name: &'static str, account_id: &str)
    -> Option<&HashMap<Id, Value>> {
    self.objects.get(&(type_name, account_id.to_owned()))
}
```

with the nested form:

```rust
struct Inner {
    objects: HashMap<&'static str, HashMap<String, HashMap<Id, Value>>>,
    states: HashMap<&'static str, HashMap<String, u64>>,
    change_log: HashMap<&'static str, HashMap<String, Vec<ChangeEntry>>>,
}

fn objects_ref(&self, type_name: &'static str, account_id: &str)
    -> Option<&HashMap<Id, Value>> {
    self.objects.get(type_name)?.get(account_id)
}
```

Inner HashMap key is `String` so `.get(account_id: &str)` works via the standard `HashMap<String, V>::get<Q: Borrow<str>>(...)` path — no allocation.

The `objects_mut` / `bump_state` write paths follow the same nested-entry pattern (`.entry(type_name).or_default().entry(account_id.to_owned()).or_default()`) — the `.to_owned()` here is on the mutation-only path which is unavoidable for HashMap insertion.

## Public API surface

MailBackend trait signatures unchanged. This is an internal storage shape refactor.

## known_accounts invariant

The bd-prime kb note 'memorybackend-objects-mut-silently-auto-registers-accounts-via-known_accounts-insert' (bd:JMAP-ayoz.36) records that objects_mut auto-registers accounts. The new nested shape preserves this — `.entry(account_id.to_owned()).or_default()` is still the auto-register call. Behavior is byte-identical from the caller's perspective.

## Acceptance

- Inner struct uses nested HashMap shape
- All read-path helpers take `&str` and don't allocate
- Write-path helpers preserve the auto-register-via-or_default invariant
- cargo test -p jmap-mail-server green
- cargo clippy -p jmap-mail-server -- -D warnings green
- Bead closure prompts next sibling propagation (chat-server .2)
